topic: Marketing: fake followers vs reels with hooks that sell (skincare)
lines: Paanch hazaar rupay mein das hazaar followers kharide, ek bhi order nahi aaya.
Kyunki followers ginti hain, customers kharidte hain.
Aapki serum ki reels mein product hai, hook nahi.
Log pehle teen second mein scroll kar jaate hain.
Hum hook, script, shoot aur edit sab karte hain.
Aur comment se DM aur order tak ka rasta banate hain.
Yeh reel kisi seller ko bhejein.
Page sale machine banana hai? Comment GROW.
